$schema_note: Phase 353 Plan 02 Task 1 (OQ-353-1, R-353-C). Four members (model-business, model-finances, protect-assets, design-solution) were added to the job vocabulary rather than forcing a wrong job onto business-model, financial-model, legal-ip and solution-design: the Jev probe measured 19-32 percent confidence with flat distributions on those four against the 16 command-derived jobs, because that vocabulary was built for commands, not sections. These four are section-canon values ONLY in this phase; no command adopts them yet, and adoption is a separate, later decision. secondary_job_id, when declared, is carried into the ruling document's generated Part 2 (methodology sequence) as the second block of the sequence, never dropped.

probe.what_crossed: section slug, the shipped One job sentence, and the 16 job ids with one-line glosses; no room content

ratification_note: This object is the frontmatter equivalent for a JSON file (JSON carries no YAML frontmatter). The navigator ratifies this canon once, as a truth about the sections rather than about any venture (OQ-353-1), by filling ratified_by and ratified_at through a future navigator act; this plan leaves both null on purpose.

personas.one_job: hold the six thinking-hat lenses built from this room, each able to research its own side, so any research question, artifact or decision can be seen from every hat before the room relies on it.
personas.one_job_note: personas/ holds the six De Bono hat lenses that /mos:persona generates, not customer personas. The section has no contract template (it is not a scaffold section), so its One job sentence lives here. Replaces the jev-probe-draft-gloss label understand-market. Hat-scoped research inside /mos:persona is not wired yet (web_scope is null); the wiring is a follow-up phase that reuses the persona-analyst research leg of /mos:bono.
